subject: Assembly hands-on workshop: scheduling, room access & recording policy
messages:
From: Jared Liu <jared.liu@assemblyhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@assemblyhealth.com>, Sophie Ren <sophie.ren@assemblyhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hands-on workshop week of Dec 14 — onsite vs virtual options

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the leadership team wants to move to a hands-on session to validate prompt routing and run a small load test against our integration. We have two preferred slots the week of Dec 14:

- Tue Dec 15, 10:00–14:00 PT (onsite at our SF office)
- Thu Dec 17, 09:30–13:30 PT (virtual)

Primary asks from our side:
- We need guidance on screen sharing vs. controlled workstation (security)
- Recording policy for internal review (legal needs to sign off)
- Visitor access instructions if onsite (badges / escort)
- A short list of prompts / routing checks you want us to pre-seed
- A lightweight load test (simulated concurrent users ~10) during the final hour

Can you confirm availability and what you need from us (AV, network, center contact)?

Appreciate it — Jared
Jared Liu
Director, Platform Operations | Assembly Health
[attachment: full-demo-synopsis.pdf (PDF)]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
To: Jared Liu <jared.liu@assemblyhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hands-on workshop week of Dec 14 — onsite vs virtual options

Hi Jared — great to hear leadership is keen. We can do either date; the onsite option is preferable for the hands-on routing review but we are happy to run remotely if that’s easier for you. Quick answers: 

- AV / screen sharing: For onsite we prefer to use both — main room projector + 1 separate workstation with screen sharing to the room (we bring our laptop). For virtual, we’ll use Zoom with screen share and request one Organizer-level user from Assembly to manage recording.
- Recording policy: We record the session only with explicit sign-off from legal. If you need us to mute or redact logs we can do that post-session.
- Visitor access: Please share a visitor list 48 hours in advance; your Ops team will need to pre-register badges.
- Prompts & routing: Please upload 10–15 canonical prompts to the shared Drive link (we’ll send a template). Rishi will pick the routing scenarios to stress.
- Load test: Ok for ~10 concurrent simulated users in final hour — Rishi will coordinate the traffic profile.

Marissa will handle physical access details. Can we tentatively book Tue Dec 15 10:00–14:00 PT (onsite) and keep Thu Dec 17 09:30–13:30 PT as a rollback? If legal needs to opt-out of recording, we can still run but will not keep session logs beyond what's needed for debugging.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[attachment: workshop-outline-v1.docx (DOCX)]
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, Jared Liu <jared.liu@assemblyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hands-on workshop week of Dec 14 — onsite vs virtual options

Following up on prompts and load test specifics. Jared — two asks from our side to make the session productive:

1) Please tag prompts by intent and expected routing (e.g., "billing->re-rank" / "claims->extract") in the Drive doc. That lets us pre-configure routing rules and cache prefixes.
2) For the load test, we prefer a stepped profile: 1, 3, 5, 10 concurrent simulated users across 10 minutes each — this shows batching and latency behavior.

For onsite network: we’ll need a port on a VLAN that allows outgoing HTTPS to redwood-inference endpoints and a short window where you can open outbound websocket (if you prefer streaming). Can your Ops team confirm a contact to work with?

I’ll bring a small test harness and a laptop with quantized model variant to validate latency/throughput during the run. If you confirm Tue Dec 15 onsite, we’ll plan to arrive 30 minutes early to set up.

—Rishi
Principal Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Ops Team <ops@assemblyhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jared Liu <jared.liu@assemblyhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 13:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hands-on workshop week of Dec 14 — onsite vs virtual options

Hi Jared / Ops — a few practical notes for onsite access should we confirm Tue the 15th:

- Visitor prereg: please complete and return the attached visitor_access_form.pdf at least 48 hours before arrival. Security will not grant badges without the form.
- Parking: Visitor lot B (enter on 4th St) is limited; consider rideshare.
- Room: We requested Conference Room A (1st floor) — it seats 12 and has HDMI + 2x USB-C inputs. Projector requires a VGA adapter, bring one if you have an older laptop.
- Recording: Redwood records local screen capture for debugging; if Assembly legal denies recording we will disable capture and maintain ephemeral logs only.
- Contacts: Onsite security: Tara Burns (tara.burns@assemblyhealth.com), Facilities: Mateo Cruz (mateo.cruz@assemblyhealth.com)

Attaching a site map and the visitor access form for your Ops team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hands-on workshop week of Dec 14 — onsite vs virtual options

Thanks everyone. Two quick updates:

1) Legal requested we avoid recording for now — they requested a brief consent email from participants. We can handle that internally; Redwood, please proceed with ephemeral logs only.
2) Ops just flagged a calendar conflict for Tue the 15th afternoon. Can we shift the onsite window earlier to 08:30–12:30 PT? That still gives the final hour for the load test at ~11:30.

If not possible, we can fall back to the virtual slot on Thu. Let me know what works for you — happy to lock in after your confirmation.

Jared
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>

Hi Jared — we can move earlier. Confirming Tue Dec 15, 08:30–12:30 PT (onsite).

Action items:
- Jared / Ops: return visitor_access_form.pdf by Thu Dec 10 (Marissa will send a reminder)
- Rishi: I’ll send the step profile and small harness this week; please review the prompts we upload to Drive by Mon Dec 14 17:00 PT
- Marissa: please confirm room booking change and coordinate with Tara for badge pickup

We’ll update the calendar invite (including Zoom fallback link) and send a brief consent template for attendees re: no recording. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
Kimberly
